# Complex Equality and Formatting Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Implement component-wise `PartialEq` and the exact user-facing `Display` contract for `Complex<T>` in `src/complex/mod.rs`, while keeping `Debug` derived and preserving special cases such as `NaN` and `-0.0`.

**Architecture:** Equality and formatting remain on the core type in `src/complex/mod.rs`. `PartialEq` is intentionally the only comparison trait. `Display` relies on a private `PositiveZero` helper to distinguish `+0.0` from `-0.0` without widening the public API.

**Tech Stack:** Rust 1.85+, edition 2024, `core::fmt::{Display, Formatter, Result}`

**Design Docs:** `design/04-complex.md` §5.8, §5.9, §8.2, §8.3, `design/00-coding.md` §7.2, §8.4

**Prerequisites:** W5T1 must be complete.

Append the following test module to `src/complex/mod.rs`:

```rust
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_eq_nan() {
        let value = Complex::new(f64::NAN, 0.0);
        assert!(value != value);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_display_format() {
        assert_eq!(Complex::new(3.0_f64, 4.0).to_string(), "3+4j");
        assert_eq!(Complex::new(3.0_f64, -4.0).to_string(), "3-4j");
        assert_eq!(Complex::new(3.0_f64, 0.0).to_string(), "3");
        assert_eq!(Complex::new(0.0_f64, 4.0).to_string(), "4j");
        assert_eq!(Complex::new(0.0_f64, 0.0).to_string(), "0");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_display_negative_zero_imag() {
        assert_eq!(Complex::new(3.0_f64, -0.0).to_string(), "3-0j");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_display_nan_imag_normalized() {
        assert_eq!(Complex::new(3.0_f64, f64::NAN).to_string(), "3+NaNj");
    }
}
```

### Task 2: Implement `PartialEq` and `Display`

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/complex/mod.rs`

- [ ] **Step 1: Add the complete equality and formatting code**

Append the following to `src/complex/mod.rs`:

```rust
impl<T: ComplexFloat> PartialEq for Complex<T> {
    #[inline]
    fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        self.re == other.re && self.im == other.im
    }
}

trait PositiveZero {
    fn is_positive_zero(self) -> bool;
}

impl PositiveZero for f32 {
    #[inline]
    fn is_positive_zero(self) -> bool {
        self.to_bits() == 0.0f32.to_bits()
    }
}

impl PositiveZero for f64 {
    #[inline]
    fn is_positive_zero(self) -> bool {
        self.to_bits() == 0.0f64.to_bits()
    }
}

#[inline]
fn scalar_is_positive_zero<T: PositiveZero>(im: T) -> bool {
    im.is_positive_zero()
}

impl<T: ComplexFloat + core::fmt::Display + PositiveZero> core::fmt::Display for Complex<T> {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut core::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> core::fmt::Result {
        if self.im != self.im {
            return write!(f, "{}+NaNj", self.re);
        }
        if self.im == T::default() {
            if scalar_is_positive_zero(self.im) {
                write!(f, "{}", self.re)
            } else {
                write!(f, "{}{}j", self.re, self.im)
            }
        } else if self.re == T::default() {
            write!(f, "{}j", self.im)
        } else if self.im > T::default() {
            write!(f, "{}+{}j", self.re, self.im)
        } else {
            write!(f, "{}{}j", self.re, self.im)
        }
    }
}
```
